gyro_bias_estimate.assumption: initial window is stationary; IMU alone does not prove this
gyro_bias_estimate.selection: first quiet interval in initial search; offline and assumed stationary, not GT-calibrated

gyro_optical_flow_correlation.model: small-rotation center dx=-fx*delta_camera_y; translation, off-center bearings and dynamic objects also affect observed flow

ground_truth_usage: evaluation only; one fixed initial orientation alignment per estimator; no GT bias/pose feedback
limitations: Attitude-only complementary visual-inertial experiment; not full VIO or SLAM
VO translation has arbitrary scale and skipped intervals; no validated metric trajectory
VO accumulated orientation loses continuity at rejected frames; its errors include those failures
Initial stationary-window bias is an assumption, not an independent calibration
Euler yaw is for visualization; quaternion/rotation error is authoritative near gimbal lock
Dynamic points, planar scenes, blur and low parallax can invalidate essential-matrix pose
